verdict.summary: The change correctly re-asserts the three existing vendored dimension IRIs as sec-prop:SecurityProperty subjects, exposes matching public constants, includes them in ALL_SECPROP_IRIS, and updates the public usage documentation. The focused test parses the actual embedded Turtle and verifies each exact IRI/type pair on the real vocabulary path; the pre-existing registry subject-presence test also now covers the added constants. The asserted IRIs, labels, and types match the vendored source, and the prose continues to distinguish annotation-based reasoning from cryptographic assurance and references the pending sq-qhy4 audit gate.
